description: This file defines the absl::optional template class, including its constructors, assignment operators, modifiers, observers, relational operators, and comparison with nullopt and other types. It provides a C++11 compatible implementation of optional semantics, similar to C++17 std::optional, with support for both internal and std::optional-based implementations.

classes.name: absl::optional
classes.description: A template class implementing optional semantics, holding either a value of type T or an empty state, with constructors, assignment, modifiers, observers, and relational operators.
